description: Defines the CKEDITOR.dom.element class, representing a DOM element with methods for creation, manipulation, styling, and attribute management within the CKEditor framework.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.element
classes.description: Represents a DOM element with methods for creation, attribute, style, and content manipulation.

methods.name: addClass
methods.description: Adds a CSS class to the element, appending if necessary.

methods.name: removeClass
methods.description: Removes a CSS class from the element.

methods.name: hasClass
methods.description: Checks if the element has a specific CSS class.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a child node or element to this element.

methods.name: appendHtml
methods.description: Sets inner HTML by appending HTML content.

methods.name: appendText
methods.description: Appends text content to the element.

methods.name: appendBogus
methods.description:
Appends a bogus
element if necessary.

methods.name: breakParent
methods.description: Breaks an ancestor element, moving this element between the broken parts.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the element contains a specific node.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets focus to the element, optionally deferred.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Returns the inner HTML of the element.

methods.name: getOuterHtml
methods.description: Returns the outer HTML of the element.

methods.name: setHtml
methods.description: Sets the inner HTML of the element.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the element.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an attribute.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns a list of child nodes.

methods.name: getComputedStyle
methods.description: Gets the computed style property value.

methods.name: getDtd
methods.description: Returns DTD entries for the element.

methods.name: getElementsByTag
methods.description: Retrieves elements by tag name.

methods.name: getTabIndex
methods.description: Returns the computed tab index.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the element.

methods.name: getWindow
methods.description: Returns the window object containing the element.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the element's ID.

methods.name: getNameAtt
methods.description: Returns the 'name' attribute.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the tag name of the element in lowercase.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the element (for form elements).

methods.name: getFirst
methods.description: Returns the first child node, optionally filtered.

methods.name: getLast
methods.description: Returns the last child node, optionally filtered.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Returns the style property value.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if the element matches one or more tag names.

methods.name: isEditable
methods.description: Checks if the element is editable.

methods.name: isIdentical
methods.description: Checks if this element is identical to another.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if the element is visible.

methods.name: isEmptyInlineRemoveable
methods.description: Checks if the inline element is empty and removable.

methods.name: hasAttributes
methods.description: Checks if the element has attributes.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a specific attribute is present.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the element (display:none).

methods.name: moveChildren
methods.description: Moves children to another element.

methods.name: mergeSiblings
methods.description: Merges adjacent sibling elements if identical.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Shows the element (restores display and visibility).

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets an attribute value.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets multiple attributes.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the element.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes an attribute.

methods.name: removeAttributes
methods.description: Removes multiple attributes.

methods.name: removeStyle
methods.description: Removes a style property.

methods.name: setStyle
methods.description: Sets a style property.

methods.name: setStyles
methods.description: Sets multiple style properties.

methods.name: setOpacity
methods.description: Sets the opacity of the element.

methods.name: unselectable
methods.description: Makes the element unselectable.

methods.name: getPositionedAncestor
methods.description: Returns the nearest ancestor with non-static position.

methods.name: getDocumentPosition
methods.description: Returns the position of the element relative to the document.

methods.name: scrollIntoView
methods.description: Scrolls the element into view.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the visual state of the element.

methods.name: getFrameDocument
methods.description: Returns the document inside an iframe element.

methods.name: copyAttributes
methods.description: Copies attributes to another element.

methods.name: renameNode
methods.description: Changes the tag name of the element.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Returns a descendant node by index.

methods.name: getChildCount
methods.description: Returns the number of child nodes.

methods.name: disableContextMenu
methods.description: Disables the context menu on the element.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the text direction of the element.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Gets or sets custom data stored as data-* attributes.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the element with box model awareness.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Gets the size of the element with box model awareness.
